findings.conflict: CR requires a distinct data field for initial margin collateral portfolio code, but EMIR only provides a single generic 'Collateral portfolio code' field
findings.spec_constraint: Only a single 'Collateral portfolio code' field exists (Table 2 Item 27 / Table 3 Item 9), up to 52 alphanumeric characters.
findings.evidence_quote: A unique code assigned by counterparty 1 to the collateral portfolio, used when collateral is reported on a portfolio basis.
findings.reasoning: EMIR REFIT does not provide a distinct data field specifically for an initial margin collateral portfolio code. The specification only includes a single generic 'Collateral portfolio code' field used to identify the overall collateral portfolio. Therefore, the requirement to have a distinct initial margin collateral portfolio code field cannot be accommodated.
